title: Late-Fee Reversal on Pre-K Tuition: Amount and Limit
content:
**Clause.** On a Pre-K tuition account of Student Enrollment, Transfers and Pre-Kindergarten Admissions, the reversal of a late fee is figured as follows.

1. The reversal is worked out on the late fee posted for the enrollment's most recent billing month (the latest billing month that carries a tuition charge) and on that month's tuition charge.
2. A most recent billing month that carries no late fee has nothing reversed.
3. The reversal is 0.00.
4. A late fee on a billing month whose tuition charge carries no eligibility credit has no reversal at all, and nothing is booked.
5. The reversal is never more than that late fee.
6. The reversal's amounts are applied in one order: first the method that applies, then additions, then the limit to the late fee. Only that final amount is rounded to the nearest cent, half a cent rounding up.

## Judging the most recent billing month

| Late fee posted for the month | Eligibility credit on the month's tuition charge | Reversal |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | 0.00, never more than the late fee |
| yes | no | none |
| no | yes | nothing reversed |
| no | no | none |

An eligibility credit is a credit with the credit reason "eligibility established" that offsets the month's tuition charge.
